title: Banggai language
description: Austronesian language spoken in Sulawesi, Indonesia
extract: The Banggai language is the main language spoken by the inhabitants of the Banggai Archipelago off the island of Sulawesi. It belongs to the Saluan–Banggai branch of the Celebic subgroup.
